title: PEB Crane Shed for Haier, 96,600 Sq Ft | Steel Mind Engineers
description: Steel Mind Engineers built a 96,600 sq ft PEB crane shed for Haier at Raiwind: 30 ft high, 184 ft wide and 525 ft long, designed for overhead cranes.
h1: PEB Crane Shed for Haier at Raiwind: 96,600 Square Feet Built for Overhead Cranes
quickAnswer: Steel Mind Engineers Pvt. Ltd. designed, fabricated and erected a pre-engineered crane shed for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore. The shed is 30 feet high, 184 feet wide and 525 feet long and covers 96,600 square feet.
alt: PEB crane shed built by Steel Mind Engineers for Haier at Raiwind, Lahore.

faq.q: How big is the Haier crane shed?
faq.a: It covers 96,600 square feet, with a width of 184 feet and a length of 525 feet.

faq.q: Can a PEB carry overhead cranes?
faq.a: Yes, if the building is designed for them from the start.

blocks.text: This is one of the two largest structures Steel Mind Engineers has built. A crane shed is a building designed around its overhead cranes, so the whole structure had to carry the crane loads along its full length of 525 feet.

Crane capacity, span, lifting height and duty set the size of the columns and runway beams. Rails must be level and straight, so the factory cuts and drills them to drawing. Crane columns carry large loads, so the foundation was planned together with the steel. Access ladders and walkways are part of the design.
Steel Mind Engineers can deliver a building of almost 100,000 square feet under one contract, from the first drawing to handover.
